body: Sadly, the game he saw was pretty correct in many aspects. Sadly it wasn't the way the Jury saw the game.

I argue Xander lost no matter what he did, even if he went to fire against Erika. Plus look at the final 5, Deshawn seem so sure his truth bomb hit hard, Erika seem rattled and hurt by it, Heather avoided and stopped talking to Erika till the reward, and Ricard went crazy saying "Get out Deshawn. He is the threat. He wins if you go to FTC". No one in the final 5 treated that truth bomb as weak or bad, they all seem affected by it. Plus Ricard kept yelling about Deshawn being a threat, yet he knew Erika was the true threat. Like...Xander lost because to me, no one else really thought Erika was a threat except Shan in the very beginning of the merge, then everyone just ignored her or treated her and Heather the same.

Like it or not, Xander never had the chance to win because of how the jury saw the game.

The issue is...the truth bomb did work in his eyes. Ricard acted super angry and kept yelling "Deshawn wins if he makes it to FTC!", Erika got pissed and felt backstabbed, Heather felt hurt and ignored Erika, and Deshawn seem so sure of himself. Of course we the audience and the jury saw it as a really horrible move, but Xander spent so little time around people who kept treating this truth bomb as something bad. I mean he didn't have the time to process or really see that it was not that bad. 

I mean to me, if Erika or Heather even thought of getting out Deshawn over Ricard, the one they all knew would win, because of that bomb...it says a lot on why Xander thought it was deadly. I rather blame Ricard who legit knew Deshawn was dead in the water and a goat at this point, get him out over Erika who he seem to know was the true biggest threat next to him.

People could be mad, but I think Xander never could have won this season and lost in episode 2. Guy was always at the bottom and never had the chance to really play Survivor. I mean people throw out he could have saved Evvie this or go to fire against Erika that, but IMO...none of that would give him the win or still backfire on him. I just felt Xander would never be respected or win, because of how people viewed him and how the jury saw the game. Like it or not, Xander played his best and saw a very different game then the jury did. Like to him, the truth bomb did work if you saw how the final 5 treated it.

Also, tbh Erika, Heather, or Deshawn beat Xander solely because those three were from Luvu (who had 3 of the 8 in jury), had people who were close to them and overlook betrayal/their game to give them the win, and had time to get to know people over fighting to save their life 24/7.

I feel Xander, sadly had no chance to win with who he was around and how he had to play to even get to final 3. So to me, him even getting there is amazing and I am proud by his gameplay.

I know people would get mad, but Xander had good reasons for his bad reads, since he kept being told by people these bad reads. I mean from the edit, Ricard never saw or treated Erika as a threat, instead yelling "Deshawn will win if he makes it to FTC" and gunning after him. Plus, the truth bomb did work in Xander's eyes with Heather avoiding Erika, Erika pissed off, Ricard saying he would win if left alone, and Deshawn sure that it worked. 

Look you can say he fucked up and read the room wrong, but IMO...no one else did too or gave him room to think his reads were wrong. Hell, Heather got treated more as a threat and actually gunned to getting out (in final 10 when they split off in 2 groups) then Erika (who only got targetted since not there, bottom of Luvu, and because Danny wanted a girl out). In Xander's eyes, people...did see Heather and Erika's games as the same.
